Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has flagged a few redlines in the Order Form and we also need to get our Ariba supplier record active before we can process POs. High-level items:

- Order Form: We proposed two edits to Section 4 (PO acknowledgement window to 5 business days) and a carveout to Section 10 (data remediation/escrow language) — see attached annotated PO template.
- We need Redwood's canonical remit-to address and tax id for our AP system.
- Ariba: our onboarding portal requires an EDI/gateway prefix and a sample 850 PO acknowledgment format to validate incoming POs.

Can you confirm who on your legal/ops side will take the redline review and an estimated timeline for getting the supplier record live? We are aiming for go-live the week of Apr 12.

Andrea

BlueSpruce Health

2) Ops (Rishi) to confirm remit-to and EDI capabilities; provide sample 850/Acknowledgement files and the EDI prefix Redwood will expose. Target: Wed, Mar 25.
3) AM (Marissa) to coordinate with BlueSpruce for Ariba registration steps and confirm the go-live window (Apr 12).

Connor

Andrea / Tom — thanks for the annotated template. Quick status update and an initial ask:

- Legal review: Kimberly has proposed narrow edits. Attached is Redwood_OrderForm_v3_redline.docx with tracked changes (summary below).
  - Section 4: PO acknowledgement now 5 business days (we accepted with an explicit allowable electronic-ack mechanism).
  - Section 10: modified escrow/data-remediation language to reference our standard data retention policy and an industry-standard escrow provider; legal limited the escrow scope to catastrophe-level data recovery only.

- Ops / EDI: Rishi confirms we can publish EDI prefix RWDX-850 for test POs and will provide a sample 850 and 997 ack format by EOD Wed, Mar 25. We recommend enabling a test endpoint in Ariba while legal completes signoff.

- Go-live sequencing we propose: Ariba supplier registration (test) -> Legal signoff on Order Form -> DocuSign envelope -> final Ariba production provisioning. That keeps the supplier record warmed and avoids a delayed first PO. Target timeline:
  - Mar 25: Ops provides EDI samples and test endpoint
  - Mar 26: Legal finalizes redline (Kim)
  - Mar 29: DocuSign sent for signature
  - Apr 05: Production provisioning in Ariba complete
  - Apr 12: First PO processing (target)

Would you be able to: (a) confirm acceptance of the limited escrow language, (b) provide the procurement contact who will perform the Ariba registration, and (c) confirm whether you prefer DocuSign or countersign?
